out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: OBSERVED NO PAPER TOWELS AT THE COOK-LINE HANDWASHING SINK OR THE BAR HANDWASHING SINK.
violations.corrective_action: PIC ADDED PAPER TOWELS DURING THE INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASHING SINKS ARE ALWAYS PROPERLY SUPPLIED.

violations.title: (2017) Non-Continuous Cooking Written Procedures
violations.observation: OBSERVED SEARED SALMON ABOUT TO BE FULLY COOKED DURING INSPECTION. PIC CONFIRMED THE SALMON WAS SEARED THE DAY PRIOR TO INSPECTION AND THE ESTABLISHMENT HAS A NON-CONTINUOUS COOK PROCESS FOR SALMON, CHICKEN, AND STEAK.
violations.corrective_action: PIC AGREED TO DISCONTINUE THIS PROCESS FOR THE TIME-BEING AND UNDERSTANDS WRITTEN PROCEDURES AND TEMPERATURE LOGS ARE REQUIRED IF THE FACILITY WISHES TO CONTINUE THIS PROCESS. PLEASE CONTACT THE EHS IF YOU HAVE ANY QUESTIONS.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: OBSERVED HONEYDEW AT 59F IN THE DISPLAY CASE.
violations.corrective_action: PIC DISCARDED HONEYDEW DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE THE DISPLAY CASE IS NOT USED UNTIL IT IS REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.corrective_action: PIC DISCARDED OF FOOD ITEMS IN THIS COOLER DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE IT IS REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety foods are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours: OBSERVED CREAM OF ASPARAGUS SOUP AT 53F AND TUSCAN SOUP AT 46-47F IN THE BACK HALLWAY WALK-IN COOLER. OBSERVED CHICKEN WINGS AT 46-49F IN RIGHT-MOST WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. PIC DISCARDED OF FOOD ITEMS DURING INSPECTION AND WILL CONTINUE TO REVIEW PROPER COOLING METHODS WITH STAFF. .

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM ONSITE DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. THE FACILITY UNDERSTANDS MORE STAFF NEED TO RECEIVE CFM CERTIFICATION TO ENSURE A CFM IS ONISTE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at handwashing sink AT THE COOK-LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PLEASE ENSURE PAPER TOWELS ARE ADDED BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION TO DESIGNATED HANDWASHING SINK.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. OBSERVED NO HANDWASHING SIGNAGE POSTED AT THE BAR HANDWASHING SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS WILL EMAIL PIC A COPY OF HANDWASHING SIGNAGE THAT MAY BE POSTED AT THE HANDWASHING SINK. PLEASE ENSURE IT IS POSTED BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION. HYATT REGENCY DULLES (Inspection Date: 10/15/2025) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock Label Marked, Last Date Served/Sold Info
violations.observation: The date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served is not recorded on the tag or label. OBSERVED THREE SHELLSTOCK TAGS IN TAG BINDER THAT WERE MISSING DATES.
violations.corrective_action: The identity of the source of shellstock (oysters, clams, mussels) that are sold or served shall be maintained by retaining shellstock tags or labels and marking the tag or label with the date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served. PLEASE ENSURE TAGS ARE ALWAYS DATE MARKED PROPERLY. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED SPINACH AT THE COLD WELL LINE AT 60F, OBSERVED INDIVIDUAL PORTIONS OF CREAM CHEESE AT 45-47F IN THE TWO-DOOR UNDER-COUNTER COOLER, OBSERVED CHICKEN WINGS AT 50F, RICE AT 46F, PASTA AT 45F, GRILLED CHICKEN AT 45F, POLENTA AT 45F, MASHED POTATOES AT 52-54F, SLICED HAM AT 45-47F, COOKED SWEET POTATOES AT 45-47F, HONEYDEW AND CANTALOUPE AT 49F, DICED TOMATOES AT 50F, FETA AT 49F, COLESLAW AT 46F IN WALK-IN COOLER #2.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OF ALL FOODS IN WALK-IN COOLER AND MOVED CREAM CHEESE/SPINACH TO ANOTHER COOLER DURING THE INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD EB KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW AND IF ICE BATHS ARE USED, FOOD ITEMS SHOULD BE FULLY SUBMERGED IN ICE.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time allowed: OBSERVED COLESLAW MADE ON 10/7 AND RED PEPPER SOUP MADE ON 9/18 IN WALK-IN COOLER #2; OBSERVED CHICKEN BASE SAUCE IN BANQUET WALK-IN COOLER DATE MARKED 10/6.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. PIC DISCARDED FOODS DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS PREPARED TCS FOODS CAN ONLY BE KEPT FOR 7 DAYS INCLUDING THE DAY OF PREPARATION.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: OBSERVED VARIOUS FOOD ITEMS PREPARED MORE THAN 24 HOURS IN ADVANCE MISSING DATE MARKINGS DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EHS DISCUSSED DATE MARKING REQUIREMENTS WITH THE PIC. PLEASE ENSURE DATE MARKING PROCEDURES ARE REVIEWED WITH STAFF PRIOR TO THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED TWO-DOOR UNDER-COUNTER COOLER AT 42F AND WALK-IN COOLER #2 AT 50F. OBSERVED HIGH TEMPERATURE DISHWASHING MACHINE MEET A MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 149F..
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC REMOVED OR DISCARDED OF TCS FOODS IN THESE COOLERS AND UNDERSTANDS THESE COOLERS SHOULD NOT BE USED TO HOLD TCS FOODS UNTIL THEY HAVE BEEN REPAIRED AND CAN PROPERLY COLD HOLD FOODS. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION BY TIME OF FOLLOW- UP INSPECTION. PIC CALLED CONTRACTOR DURING INSPECTION FOR THE DISHWASHING MACHINE. PLEASE ENSURE DISHWASHING MACHINE IS REPAIRED AND CAN MEET 160F BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP.
